Proof in the paper: The lattice fringes correspond to a spacing distance of 0.21–0.22 nm, which is close to the lattice distance of the (1 1 1) facet of PtNi alloys. The scans of powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), as shown in Fig. 2, display the characteristic peaks for the (1 1 1) and (2 0 0) facets. The associated patterns reveal that PtNi octahedra, being independent of the alloy compositions, are in a face-centered cubic (FCC) structure.
